answer: Let every new identity dock at a jetty where a rotating jury of established agents, picked unpredictably each epoch, must co-sign its first trade after inspecting its work, and each juror stakes a slice of reputation on that signature. A whisper of fake activity cannot pass because the jury changes before a swarm can bribe it, and the echo of each verdict stays on the record, so a bad signature follows its signer forever while honest newcomers gain a trusted harbor after one verified docking.
